Events.Title: The Frozen Shrine
Events.Callout: A Warden shrine in the snow has gone dark. Its braziers are cold, and something is moving in the drifts.
Events.Success: The shrine burns again. The Wardens say a lit shrine keeps the Titan's dreams quiet.
Events.Failure: The braziers froze over before you could light them all.

Events.Title: Wounded Warden
Events.Callout: A Frost Warden is down in the snow, bleeding and too stubborn to say so. Get her back to the outpost.
Events.Objective: Get the Warden back to the outpost
Events.Success: The Warden limps through the gate and tells everyone she was fine.
Events.Failure: The Warden didn't make it back.
Events.Name: Wounded Warden

Lines.Speaker: Wounded Warden
Lines.Text: Don't look at me like that. It's a scratch. A big scratch. Fine, walk me home.

Events.Title: Griffin Feather
Events.Callout: A Rime Griffin dropped a flight feather in the snow. It never melts, and the griffin wants it back.
Events.Objective: Grab the feather before the griffin returns
Events.Success: The feather is yours. It is colder than the snow it fell on.
Events.Failure: The griffin took its feather back.

Events.Title: Frost Stalker Sighting
Events.Callout: Fresh stalker tracks, circling. A Frost Stalker is hunting near here. Keep away, or claim the Warden bounty.
Events.Objective: Keep your distance, or claim the bounty
Events.Success: The stalker is down. The Warden bounty is paid in cash and respect.

Events.Title: Snow Hollow Pack
Events.Callout: A pack of Snow Hollows is drifting across the snowfield toward the outpost road.
Events.Success: The pack is broken. The snow goes back to being just snow.

Events.Title: Stranded Campers
Events.Callout: Two campers lit a fire in the wrong place. Snow Hollows love a warm meal.
Events.Success: The campers swear they will only ever camp in hotels from now on.
Events.Failure: The campfire burns on with nobody beside it.

Events.Title: Buried Supply Cache
Events.Callout: A Warden supply cache is half buried in a drift. Something big is sleeping on top of it.
Events.Objective: Deal with the guard, then dig out the supplies
Events.Success: Lamp oil, dried meat and a very old flask. The Wardens will want the flask back.

Events.Title: Warden Camp Under Siege
Events.Callout: A Warden patrol camp is fighting off Snow Hollows by the fire. They could use one more pair of hands.
Events.Objective: Hold the camp with the Wardens
Events.Success: The camp holds. The patrol shares their coffee, which is a great honour and a terrible coffee.
Events.Failure: The camp fell. The Wardens will mourn their own.

Events.Title: The Ice Pilgrim
Events.Callout: A pilgrim is walking barefoot through the snow toward Titan Hollow, singing to the ice.
Events.Name: Pilgrim Saska

Lines.Speaker: Pilgrim Saska
Lines.Text: Don't worry about my feet. They stopped complaining an hour ago.

Lines.Speaker: Pilgrim Saska
Lines.Text: The ice sings, if you listen. It sings about a giant who dreams of a city that isn't built yet. Then it sings about lunch.

Lines.Speaker: Pilgrim Saska
Lines.Text: Warm is overrated. Here, take this. The Titan gave it to me in a dream. Or I found it. One of those.
